prompt.en: Every time a cow leaves, you drop one pebble in a pot. 4 cows have left. How many pebbles are in the pot?
prompt.hi: Har baar ek gaay jaati hai, tum matke mein ek kankad daalte ho. 4 gaayein gayi hain. Matke mein kitne kankad hain?

prompt.en: Chotu is keeping track of cows. A big cow went out, so he made 2 marks for it. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Chotu gaayon ka hisaab rakh raha hai. Ek badi gaay bahar gayi toh usne 2 mark bana diye. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Does a big cow count as more than one cow?

prompt.en: On the wall there are 4 marks: | | | |. Show the same number with your fingers.
prompt.hi: Deewar pe 4 mark hain: | | | |. Utni hi ungliyan dikhao.

challenges.hint: Put up one finger for each mark.

prompt.en: How many does this tally show: one bundle and 3 loose lines?
prompt.hi: Yeh tally kitna dikhata hai: ek bundle aur 3 alag lines?

challenges.hint: Start at 5 and count on the loose lines.

prompt.en: How many is 3 bundles and 1 loose line?
prompt.hi: 3 bundle aur 1 alag line, kitne hue?

prompt.en: At the mela, {friendF} kept tallies of balloons sold: 5 bundles and 2 loose lines. How many balloons did she sell?
prompt.hi: Mele mein {friendF} ne bike gubbaaron ki tally rakhi: 5 bundle aur 2 alag lines. Kitne gubbaare bike?

prompt.en: Arjun says this tally shows 10: five standing lines with one line across them. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Arjun kehta hai yeh tally 10 dikhata hai: paanch khadi lines aur unke upar ek aadi line. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: A bundle has only 4 standing lines.

prompt.en: In a cricket match you make a tally for every run Rohit scores. At the end there are 6 bundles and 4 loose lines. Did he score a half-century (50)?
prompt.hi: Cricket match mein Rohit ke har run ki tally banayi. End mein 6 bundle aur 4 alag lines hain. Kya usne half-century (50) banayi?

challenges.hint: Count in 5s six times, then add 4.

prompt.en: Quick! One bundle and 4 loose lines. How many?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Ek bundle aur 4 alag lines. Kitne?

prompt.en: Which shape is a round candle: cone, cylinder or cuboid?
prompt.hi: Gol mombatti kaunsi shape hai: cone, cylinder ya cuboid?

challenges.hint: It has flat circle ends and a curved side.

prompt.en: How many flat faces does a cone have?
prompt.hi: Cone mein kitne chapte face hote hain?

challenges.hint: Only its bottom is flat; the rest is curved.

prompt.en: Meena says a matchbox is a cube. Is she right?
prompt.hi: Meena kehti hai maachis ki dibbi cube hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: {friendF} drew the top view of a birthday cap as a triangle. Is that right?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ne birthday cap ka upar wala view tikon banaya. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: What is the outline you see from the top?

prompt.en: You and Golu sit facing each other. A cup is between you with its handle pointing at you. Before we check: will Golu see the handle?
prompt.hi: Tum aur Golu aamne-saamne ho. Beech mein cup hai, handle tumhari taraf. Check karne se pehle batao: kya Golu ko handle dikhega?

challenges.hint: Golu looks from the other side.

prompt.en: 1 bundle of hundred, 3 bundles of ten and 4 loose sticks. What number is it?
prompt.hi: Sau ka 1 bundle, das ke 3 bundle aur 4 khuli teeliyan. Kaunsa number hua?

prompt.en: Write 'one hundred eighty-seven' in numbers.
prompt.hi: 'One hundred eighty-seven' ko number mein likho.

prompt.en: What number comes just after 149?
prompt.hi: 149 ke turant baad kaunsa number aata hai?

prompt.en: 125 and 152 both have a 5. Does the 5 mean the same thing in both?
prompt.hi: 125 aur 152 dono mein 5 hai. Kya dono mein 5 ka matlab ek hi hai?

prompt.en: Before you count on: what number will you get if you add 1 to 199?
prompt.hi: Aage ginne se pehle batao: 199 mein 1 jodo toh kya milega?

challenges.hint: Then the tens are full too.

prompt.en: Chintu wrote 'one hundred six' as 1006. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Chintu ne 'one hundred six' ko 1006 likha. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Hundreds, tens, ones: one digit each.

prompt.en: A notebook has 200 pages. You are on page 190. What page is 10 pages later?
prompt.hi: Copy mein 200 panne hain. Tum panna 190 pe ho. 10 panne baad kaunsa panna hoga?

prompt.en: The school has 1 box of 100 chalks, 7 packets of 10 chalks and 6 loose chalks. The principal says they have more than 170 chalks. Is she right?
prompt.hi: School mein 100 chalk ka 1 dibba, 10-10 chalk ke 7 packet aur 6 khuli chalk hain. Principal kehti hain 170 se zyada chalk hain. Kya woh sahi hain?

prompt.en: What is 10 more than 145?
prompt.hi: 145 se 10 zyada kitna hai?

challenges.hint: The tens digit goes up by 1.

prompt.en: 30 and how much make 100?
prompt.hi: 30 aur kitna milake 100 banta hai?

prompt.en: You have ₹80. How much more do you need to make ₹100?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?

prompt.en: What goes with 48 to make 100?
prompt.hi: 48 ke saath kya milaayein ki 100 ban jaaye?

prompt.en: Bholu is on 65. He jumps 5 to reach 70. How many jumps of 10 does he need now to reach 100?
prompt.hi: Bholu 65 pe hai. Woh 5 ki chhalaang lagake 70 pe pahunchta hai. Ab 100 tak 10-10 ki kitni chhalaang chahiye?

prompt.en: Golu says 60 needs 4 more to make 100, because 6 and 4 make 10. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai 60 ko 100 banane ke liye 4 chahiye, kyunki 6 aur 4 se 10 banta hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A batter is on 87 runs. How many more runs for a century?
prompt.hi: Batter 87 run pe hai. Century ke liye aur kitne run chahiye?

prompt.en: You pay with a ₹100 note for a packet of toffees that costs ₹38. How much change do you get?
prompt.hi: ₹38 ki toffee ka packet liya aur ₹100 ka note diya. Kitne paise wapas milenge?

prompt.en: What goes with 40 to make 100?
prompt.hi: 40 ke saath kya milaayein ki 100 bane?

prompt.en: You put marbles in groups of 10. You made 9 groups, and 7 are left over. How many marbles?
prompt.hi: Tumne kanche 10-10 ke group mein rakhe. 9 group bane aur 7 bach gaye. Kitne kanche hain?

prompt.en: At a langar, rotis are kept in stacks of 10. There are 10 full stacks. How many rotis?
prompt.hi: Langar mein rotiyan 10-10 ki gaddi mein rakhi hain. 10 poori gaddiyan hain. Kitni rotiyan?

prompt.en: Golu estimated 100 laddoos. He counted 98. He says 'my estimate was wrong'. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu ne 100 laddoo ka andaaza lagaya. Ginne pe 98 nikle. Woh kehta hai 'mera andaaza galat tha'. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Nani Maa had 24 stamps. She bought 13 more. How many stamps does she have now?
prompt.hi: Nani Maa ke paas 24 daak ticket (stamp) the. Unhone 13 aur khareede. Ab kitne hain?

prompt.en: There were 56 balushahis. The guests ate 23. How many are left?
prompt.hi: 56 balushahi thi. Mehmaan 23 kha gaye. Kitni bachi?

prompt.en: {friendF} has 40 marbles. That is 15 more than Golu has. How many marbles does Golu have?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ke paas 40 kanche hain. Yeh Golu se 15 zyada hain. Golu ke paas kitne hain?

challenges.hint: Golu has fewer, so take the extra away.

prompt.en: Nani's mango tree gave 62 mangoes. The neighbour's tree gave 48. How many more mangoes came from Nani's tree?
prompt.hi: Nani ke aam ke ped se 62 aam mile. Padosi ke ped se 48. Nani ke ped se kitne zyada aam mile?

prompt.en: Before you work it out: 'Raju had 50 stamps and gave 18 to his friend.' Will the answer be more than 50 or less than 50?
prompt.hi: Hal karne se pehle batao: 'Raju ke paas 50 daak ticket (stamp) the, usne 18 dost ko de diye.' Jawab 50 se zyada hoga ya kam?

prompt.en: Golu solved: 'A train had 65 people. At a station 20 got off. How many now?' He wrote 65 + 20 = 85. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu ne hal kiya: 'Train mein 65 log the. Station pe 20 utar gaye. Ab kitne?' Usne likha 65 + 20 = 85. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Raju had some stamps. Nani gave him 15 more. Now he has 42. How many did he have at first?
prompt.hi: Raju ke paas kuch daak ticket (stamp) the. Nani ne 15 aur diye. Ab 42 hain. Shuru mein kitne the?

prompt.en: Fill the blank: 30 = 18 + ___
prompt.hi: Khaali jagah bharo: 30 = 18 + ___

challenges.hint: Both sides must be the same amount.

prompt.en: {friendF} has 25 pencils. Golu has 18. How many fewer pencils does Golu have?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ke paas 25 pencil hain. Golu ke paas 18. Golu ke paas kitni kam hain?

prompt.en: Try it with 15: add 9, then take away 15. What do you get?
prompt.hi: 15 ke saath karo: 9 jodo, phir 15 ghatao. Kya mila?

prompt.en: Before you try: if you start with 50, add 9 and then take away 50, what will you get?
prompt.hi: Karne se pehle batao: 50 se shuru karo, 9 jodo, phir 50 ghatao. Kya milega?

challenges.hint: Your number goes in and then comes out.

prompt.en: 4 sticks are left and it is your turn. Choice A: take 2. Choice B: take 1. Which choice makes you win?
prompt.hi: 4 teeliyan bachi hain, tumhari baari. A: 2 uthao. B: 1 uthao. Kis choice se jeetoge?

challenges.hint: Your friend wins if they can take all that is left.

prompt.en: Show the trick 'add 9, take away your number' with a closed box: put your secret number in a box, add 9 counters, then take the box away. What is left?
prompt.hi: Trick ko band dabbe se dikhao: apna number dabbe mein rakho, 9 counter jodo, phir dabba hata do. Kya bacha?

challenges.hint: Your number, which we do not need to know.

prompt.en: In the stick game where you take 1 or 2, how many sticks do you want to leave for your friend?
prompt.hi: 1 ya 2 teeli wale khel mein, dost ke liye kitni teeliyan chhodni chahiye?

challenges.hint: Whatever they take, you take the rest.

prompt.en: Start at 20. Jump 10 two times. Where are you?
prompt.hi: 20 se shuru karo. 10 ki do chhalaang lagao. Kahaan ho?

prompt.en: Start at 35. Jump 10, then make 3 jumps of 1. Where do you land?
prompt.hi: 35 se shuru karo. 10 ki chhalaang, phir 1-1 ki 3 chhalaang. Kahaan pahunche?

prompt.en: Use jumps on the number line: 46 + 23 = ?
prompt.hi: Number line pe chhalaang se: 46 + 23 = ?

prompt.en: Start at 78. Jump back 10 two times, then 1 three times. Where are you?
prompt.hi: 78 se shuru karo. Peeche 10 ki do chhalaang, phir 1 ki 3. Kahaan ho?

prompt.en: How many jumps of 1 from 52 to 57?
prompt.hi: 52 se 57 tak 1-1 ki kitni chhalaang?

prompt.en: Golu did 25 + 4 on the number line. He said '25, 26, 27, 28' and wrote 28. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Golu ne number line pe 25 + 4 kiya. Usne bola '25, 26, 27, 28' aur 28 likha. Kya yeh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A train is at the 84 km stone. It goes back 30 km. Which stone is it at now?
prompt.hi: Train 84 km wale pathhar pe hai. Woh 30 km peeche jaati hai. Ab kaunse pathhar pe hai?

prompt.en: An auto-rickshaw goes from the 18 km stone to the 63 km stone. How many km did it go? Use jumps.
prompt.hi: Auto 18 km wale pathhar se 63 km wale pathhar tak gaya. Kitne km chala? Chhalaang se nikaalo.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to do 34 + 25 on a number line.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao ki number line pe 34 + 25 kaise karein.

prompt.en: Start at 60. Jump back 10. Where are you?
prompt.hi: 60 se shuru karo. 10 peeche jao. Kahaan ho?

prompt.en: How many corners does a triangle have?
prompt.hi: Tikon mein kitne kone hote hain?

prompt.en: A rectangular window has how many sides?
prompt.hi: Rectangle wali khidki ki kitni bhujaayein hain?

prompt.en: I will turn this square so it stands on a corner. Guess: will it still be a square?
prompt.hi: Main is square ko ghuma ke kone pe khada karungi. Guess karo: kya woh ab bhi square rahega?

challenges.hint: Sides and corners stay the same.

prompt.en: Golu says: 'A square on the chessboard is not a rectangle, because rectangles are long.' Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Chessboard ka square rectangle nahi hai, kyunki rectangle lamba hota hai.' Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A rangoli has 2 triangles and 1 square. How many corners are there in all?
prompt.hi: Ek rangoli mein 2 tikon aur 1 square hain. Kul kitne kone?

challenges.hint: 3 + 3 for the triangles, 4 for the square.

prompt.en: In a window grill made of squares, Golu sees a shape made of 2 small squares side by side. Is it a square, a rectangle, or both?
prompt.hi: Squares se bani khidki ki grill mein Golu ko 2 chhote square saath-saath dikhe. Yeh shape square hai, rectangle hai, ya dono?

challenges.hint: It is 2 squares long but 1 square wide.

prompt.en: How many sides does a rectangle have, and which sides are equal?
prompt.hi: Rectangle ki kitni bhujaayein hoti hain, aur kaunsi barabar hoti hain?

challenges.hint: Top and bottom match; left and right match.

prompt.en: Cut a square paper from one corner to the opposite corner. How many pieces, and what shape?
prompt.hi: Square kaagaz ko ek kone se saamne wale kone tak kaato. Kitne tukde, aur kis shape ke?

challenges.hint: Count the sides of each piece.

prompt.en: In a tangram, how many small triangles fit exactly on the square piece?
prompt.hi: Tangram mein kitne chhote tikon square tukde pe theek se fit hote hain?

prompt.en: I have a square made of 4 small tiles. I will line the tiles up in one row. Guess: will the row cover more table, less, or the same?
prompt.hi: 4 chhoti tiles se square bana hai. Main tiles ko ek line mein rakh dungi. Guess karo: line zyada jagah legi, kam, ya barabar?

challenges.hint: Moving does not add or remove tiles.

prompt.en: {friendF} says a square cannot be cut into triangles, only into smaller squares. Is she right?
prompt.hi: {friendF} kehti hai square ko tikon mein nahi kaat sakte, sirf chhote squares mein. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Try from one corner to the opposite corner.

prompt.en: What two shapes does a square split into when you cut it from corner to corner?
prompt.hi: Square ko kone se kone tak kaatne pe kaunsi do shapes banti hain?

prompt.en: How many corners does a rectangle-shaped slate have?
prompt.hi: Rectangle wali slate mein kitne kone hain?

challenges.hint: Two at the top, two at the bottom.

prompt.en: Before we cut: if I cut a round roti straight across the middle, will each half have corners? How many?
prompt.hi: Kaatne se pehle batao: gol roti ko beech se seedha kaatun toh har aadhe mein kone honge? Kitne?

challenges.hint: A straight edge meets the curve at its ends.

prompt.en: Golu says a circle has 1 corner, the place where his pencil started. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai gole mein 1 kona hai, jahaan uski pencil shuru hui. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: A corner needs two edges to meet.

prompt.en: On a dot grid, can you join 4 dots to make a square that stands on its corner?
prompt.hi: Dot grid pe kya 4 dot jod ke kone pe khada square bana sakte ho?

challenges.hint: Any two dots can be joined.

prompt.en: You are making a rangoli on a dot grid and want round petals. Can you make truly round petals with straight lines only?
prompt.hi: Tum dot grid pe rangoli bana rahe ho aur gol pankhudiyan chahiye. Kya sirf seedhi lines se sach mein gol pankhudi ban sakti hai?

challenges.hint: What do straight lines make where they meet?

prompt.en: 3 notes of ₹100, 4 notes of ₹10 and 2 coins of ₹1. How much money?
prompt.hi: ₹100 ke 3 note, ₹10 ke 4 note aur ₹1 ke 2 sikke. Kitne paise?

prompt.en: Write 'four hundred seven' in numbers.
prompt.hi: 'Four hundred seven' ko number mein likho.

prompt.en: {friendF} wrote 'two hundred fifty' as 20050. Is that right?
prompt.hi: {friendF} ne 'two hundred fifty' ko 20050 likha. Kya yeh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A shopkeeper has 1 bundle of 100 rakhis, 12 packets of 10 rakhis and 3 single rakhis. How many rakhis?
prompt.hi: Dukaandaar ke paas 100 rakhiyon ka 1 bundle, 10-10 ke 12 packet aur 3 alag rakhiyan hain. Kitni rakhiyan?

prompt.en: Teach Golu what each digit in 572 means.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao ki 572 mein har ank ka kya matlab hai.

prompt.en: How do you write seven hundred ten?
prompt.hi: Seven hundred ten kaise likhte hain?

prompt.en: Which is more: 520 or 250?
prompt.hi: Kaun zyada hai: 520 ya 250?

prompt.en: Which train has more seats: one with 386 seats or one with 368 seats?
prompt.hi: Kis train mein zyada seat hain: 386 wali ya 368 wali?

prompt.en: Which is less: 709 or 790?
prompt.hi: Kaun kam hai: 709 ya 790?

prompt.en: Before you compare: train A has 299 seats, train B has 301. Which has more?
prompt.hi: Compare karne se pehle batao: train A mein 299 seat, train B mein 301. Kismein zyada?

prompt.en: Compare 645 and 654. Both start with 6. Where do they become different, and which is bigger?
prompt.hi: 645 aur 654 compare karo. Dono 6 se shuru. Fark kahaan aata hai, aur kaun bada hai?

challenges.hint: Hundreds are the same. Look next at?

prompt.en: Golu wrote 450 < 405. Is it correct?
prompt.hi: Golu ne likha 450 < 405. Kya yeh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Show 299 and 301 on a number line. Which one is to the right, and what does that mean?
prompt.hi: 299 aur 301 ko number line pe dikhao. Kaun daayein taraf hai, aur iska matlab kya hai?

prompt.en: Which is bigger: 199 or 201?
prompt.hi: Kaun bada hai: 199 ya 201?

prompt.en: 3 plates have 2 laddoos on each. How many laddoos?
prompt.hi: 3 plate mein 2-2 laddoo hain. Kitne laddoo?

prompt.en: Rakhis on a thali are in 4 rows, with 3 in each row. How many rakhis?
prompt.hi: Thaali mein rakhiyan 4 line mein hain, har line mein 3. Kitni rakhiyan?

challenges.hint: Skip count by 3 for each row.

prompt.en: Before counting: 4 auto-rickshaws have 3 children in each. Will there be more than 10 children or fewer?
prompt.hi: Ginne se pehle batao: 4 auto mein 3-3 bachche hain. 10 se zyada bachche honge ya kam?

prompt.en: Golu says 4 groups of 5 make 9. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai 5-5 ke 4 group mein 9 hote hain. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A classroom has 5 rows of benches. 4 children sit in each row. How many children?
prompt.hi: Class mein bench ki 5 line hain. Har line mein 4 bachche. Kitne bachche?

prompt.en: How many things are in 3 rows of 3?
prompt.hi: 3-3 ki 3 line mein kitni cheezein?

prompt.en: 6 brothers each get 2 rakhis. How many rakhis?
prompt.hi: 6 bhaiyon ko 2-2 rakhi milti hain. Kitni rakhiyan?

prompt.en: 6 brothers each get 3 rakhis. How many rakhis?
prompt.hi: 6 bhaiyon ko 3-3 rakhi milti hain. Kitni rakhiyan?

prompt.en: Golu says: '5 × 4 = 20, so 6 × 4 = 26.' Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai: '5 × 4 = 20, toh 6 × 4 = 26.' Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Each auto-rickshaw has 3 wheels. How many wheels do 5 autos have?
prompt.hi: Har auto ke 3 pahiye hain. 5 auto ke kitne pahiye?

prompt.en: A batter hits 6 fours. How many runs from fours?
prompt.hi: Batter ne 6 chauke maare. Chaukon se kitne run?

prompt.en: What is 1 × 7?
prompt.hi: 1 × 7 kitna hota hai?

prompt.en: What is 10 × 7?
prompt.hi: 10 × 7 kitna hai?

prompt.en: A chapati is folded so both sides match exactly. Are the two parts equal?
prompt.hi: Chapati ko aise moda ki dono taraf bilkul mil gayi. Kya dono hisse barabar hain?

prompt.en: Into how many equal parts do we cut a roti to give a quarter to each person?
prompt.hi: Har ek ko chauthaai dene ke liye roti ke kitne barabar tukde karein?

prompt.en: How many quarters make a half?
prompt.hi: Kitne chauthaai milke aadha banta hai?

challenges.hint: Fold a paper in half, then in half again.

prompt.en: How many halves make a whole?
prompt.hi: Kitne aadhe milke poora banta hai?

prompt.en: What is half of 8 bangles?
prompt.hi: 8 choodiyon ka aadha kitna?

challenges.hint: One for you, one for me …

prompt.en: Half a dozen bananas: how many is that?
prompt.hi: Aadha darjan kele: kitne hue?

prompt.en: What is half of 14 marbles?
prompt.hi: 14 kanchon ka aadha kitna?

challenges.hint: Half of 10 is 5, half of 4 is 2.

prompt.en: What is a quarter of 8 rotis?
prompt.hi: 8 rotiyon ka chauthaai kitna?

challenges.hint: Share into 4, or take half of half.

prompt.en: What is a quarter of ₹20?
prompt.hi: ₹20 ka chauthaai kitna?

challenges.hint: Half of 20 is 10; half of 10 is …

prompt.en: Golu says a quarter of 16 is 4 'because quarter means 4'. His number is right! Is his reason right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai 16 ka chauthaai 4 hai 'kyunki chauthaai matlab 4'. Number sahi hai! Kya uski wajah sahi hai?

challenges.hint: A quarter means 4 equal shares, not the answer 4.

prompt.en: A ribbon is 10 handspans long. Fold it in half. How long is each half?
prompt.hi: Ek ribbon 10 baalisht lamba hai. Use aadha modo. Har aadha kitna lamba?

prompt.en: Nani has ₹40. She gives half to {friendF}, and then half of what is left to Golu. How much does Golu get?
prompt.hi: Nani ke paas ₹40 hain. Woh aadha {friendF} ko deti hain, phir jo bacha uska aadha Golu ko. Golu ko kitna mila?

challenges.hint: Half of 40 is 20, so 20 is left.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to find half of 10 marbles.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao ki 10 kanchon ka aadha kaise nikaalein.

challenges.hint: Give one to each group in turn.

prompt.en: What is half of 10?
prompt.hi: 10 ka aadha kitna?

prompt.en: On the number line, which hundred comes after 600?
prompt.hi: Number line pe 600 ke baad kaunsa sau aata hai?

prompt.en: How many hundreds make 1000?
prompt.hi: Kitne sau milke 1000 banta hai?

prompt.en: What number is halfway between 300 and 400?
prompt.hi: 300 aur 400 ke theek beech mein kaunsa number hai?

prompt.en: Is 380 nearer to 300 or to 400?
prompt.hi: 380, 300 ke paas hai ya 400 ke?

prompt.en: A dot is exactly halfway between 700 and 800 on the line. Write the number and say it in words.
prompt.hi: Line pe ek dot 700 aur 800 ke theek beech mein hai. Number likho aur shabdon mein bolo.

prompt.en: What number is halfway between 500 and 600?
prompt.hi: 500 aur 600 ke theek beech mein kaunsa number hai?

prompt.en: What comes next: 341, 342, 343, ___?
prompt.hi: Aage kya aayega: 341, 342, 343, ___?
Neeche jaate hue: 780, 770, 760, ___

prompt.en: Before adding: 457 + 10. Which digit will change, and what will you get?
prompt.hi: Jodne se pehle batao: 457 + 10. Kaunsa ank badlega, aur kya milega?

prompt.en: Compare 352 + 1, 352 + 10 and 352 + 100. Which digit changes each time?
prompt.hi: 352 + 1, 352 + 10 aur 352 + 100 dekho. Har baar kaunsa ank badalta hai?

prompt.en: Birbal counted crows going up by 10: 485, 495, ___, 515. What is missing?
prompt.hi: Birbal ne kauve 10-10 badhte hue gine: 485, 495, ___, 515. Kya chhoot gaya?

challenges.hint: 9 tens and 1 more ten make a hundred.

prompt.en: Show 503 − 10 with blocks or notes. What must you do first?
prompt.hi: 503 − 10 ko blocks ya noton se dikhao. Pehle kya karna padega?

prompt.en: Bus passes are numbered going up by 10: 875, 885, 895. Your pass is 3 passes after 895. What is your number?
prompt.hi: Bus pass ke number 10-10 badhte hain: 875, 885, 895. Tumhara pass 895 ke 3 pass baad hai. Tumhara number kya hai?

prompt.en: What is 100 more than 456?
prompt.hi: 456 se 100 zyada kitna hai?

prompt.en: An eraser starts at 0 and ends at 4 on the scale. How long is it?
prompt.hi: Rubber scale pe 0 se shuru hokar 4 pe khatam hota hai. Kitna lamba hai?

challenges.hint: It starts at 0, so read the end.

prompt.en: A crayon starts at 2 and ends at 9 on the scale. How long is it?
prompt.hi: Crayon scale pe 2 se shuru hokar 9 pe khatam hota hai. Kitna lamba hai?

prompt.en: How many centimetres make 1 metre?
prompt.hi: 1 metre mein kitne centimetre hote hain?

challenges.hint: Count the small cm gaps from 0 to the end.

prompt.en: Would you measure a dupatta in centimetres or metres?
prompt.hi: Dupatta naapne ke liye centimetre loge ya metre?

challenges.hint: Long things are measured in bigger units.

prompt.en: Golu put a pencil from 1 to 11 on the scale and said it is 11 cm. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu ne pencil scale pe 1 se 11 tak rakhi aur bola 11 cm. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: {friendF} is 1 m and 25 cm tall. How many centimetres is that?
prompt.hi: {friendF} 1 m aur 25 cm lambi hai. Kitne centimetre hue?

prompt.en: Where on the scale do we put the start of the thing we measure?
prompt.hi: Jo cheez naapni hai uska shuru scale pe kahaan rakhte hain?

prompt.en: How many cm is half a metre?
prompt.hi: Aadha metre kitne cm hota hai?

prompt.en: How many cm is a quarter metre?
prompt.hi: Chauthaai metre kitne cm hota hai?

prompt.en: How many half metres make 1 metre?
prompt.hi: Kitne aadhe metre milke 1 metre banta hai?

prompt.en: How many quarter metres make 1 metre?
prompt.hi: Kitne chauthaai metre milke 1 metre banta hai?

prompt.en: Before we unroll them: will 2 quarter-metre ribbons placed end to end be as long as half a metre?
prompt.hi: Kholne se pehle batao: kya 2 chauthaai metre ke ribbon milake aadhe metre jitne lambe honge?

prompt.en: For the class party you need 1 and a half metres of ribbon. How many cm is that?
prompt.hi: Class party ke liye 1 aur aadha metre ribbon chahiye. Kitne cm hue?

prompt.en: Show 75 cm using quarter-metre pieces.
prompt.hi: 75 cm ko chauthaai metre ke tukdon se dikhao.

prompt.en: Each paper chain for the party needs a quarter metre of ribbon. You have 2 metres. How many chains can you make?
prompt.hi: Party ki har chain ke liye chauthaai metre ribbon chahiye. Tumhare paas 2 metre hain. Kitni chain banaoge?

prompt.en: How many quarter metres make half a metre?
prompt.hi: Kitne chauthaai metre milke aadha metre banta hai?

challenges.hint: 25 cm, and half a metre is 50 cm.

prompt.en: How many half-litre bottles make 1 litre?
prompt.hi: Kitni aadhe litre ki bottle milke 1 litre banti hai?

prompt.en: A bucket holds 10 litres. You pour in 4 litres. How many more litres will fill it?
prompt.hi: Baalti mein 10 litre aata hai. Tumne 4 litre daale. Aur kitne litre se bharegi?

prompt.en: How many half litres make 3 litres?
prompt.hi: 3 litre mein kitne aadhe litre?

prompt.en: Before pouring: a full steel glass of water is poured into a tall, thin glass. Will there be more water, less, or the same?
prompt.hi: Daalne se pehle batao: bhara steel ka glass ek lambe patle glass mein daalenge. Paani zyada hoga, kam, ya barabar?

challenges.hint: Only the glass changes. Does the water itself change?

prompt.en: Golu says the tall, thin bottle must hold more than the round matka because it is taller. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai lambi patli bottle mein gol matke se zyada aata hai kyunki woh lambi hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: How could you check for sure?

prompt.en: A family uses 2 litres of milk each day. How many litres in 5 days?
prompt.hi: Ek parivaar roz 2 litre doodh leta hai. 5 din mein kitne litre?

prompt.en: You pour 2 half-litre glasses into an empty measuring jug. Up to which mark will it be filled?
prompt.hi: Khaali measuring jug mein aadhe-aadhe litre ke 2 glass daale. Kis nishaan tak bharega?

challenges.hint: Half and half make a whole.

prompt.en: The school water cooler holds 20 litres. Each child's bottle holds half a litre. How many bottles can be filled?
prompt.hi: School ke water cooler mein 20 litre aata hai. Har bachche ki bottle mein aadha litre. Kitni bottle bharengi?

prompt.en: Two half-litre milk packets: how many litres is that?
prompt.hi: Aadhe litre ke do doodh ke packet: kitne litre hue?

prompt.en: On a balance, the side with the atta bag goes down. Which is heavier: the atta bag or the other side?
prompt.hi: Taraazu pe aate ki thaili wala palda neeche jaata hai. Kaun bhaari hai: aate ki thaili ya doosra palda?

prompt.en: How many half-kilogram weights balance 1 kg?
prompt.hi: Kitne aadhe kilo ke baat 1 kg ke barabar hote hain?

prompt.en: Onions balance a 1 kg weight and a half kg weight. How much do the onions weigh?
prompt.hi: Pyaaz 1 kg aur aadha kg ke baat ke barabar hain. Pyaaz kitne bhaari hain?

prompt.en: Amma buys 2 kg of rice and 3 kg of atta. What is the total weight?
prompt.hi: Amma 2 kg chaawal aur 3 kg aata kharidti hain. Kul vazan kitna?

prompt.en: A watermelon balances 3 kg. How much do two such watermelons weigh?
prompt.hi: Ek tarbooz 3 kg ke barabar hai. Do aise tarbooz kitne bhaari?

prompt.en: Show 2 and a half kg using 1 kg and half kg weights.
prompt.hi: 1 kg aur aadhe kg ke baat se dhaai kilo dikhao.

prompt.en: Your school bag weighs 5 kg. You take out books weighing 2 kg. How much does it weigh now? Is it lighter than 4 kg?
prompt.hi: Tumhara school bag 5 kg ka hai. Tumne 2 kg ki kitaabein nikaali. Ab kitna bhaari hai? Kya 4 kg se halka hai?

prompt.en: Two half kilograms make how much?
prompt.hi: Do aadhe kilo milke kitna?

prompt.en: Kishan's nursery has 213 rose saplings and 145 tulsi saplings. How many saplings in all?
prompt.hi: Kishan ki nursery mein 213 gulaab ke paudhe aur 145 tulsi ke paudhe hain. Kul kitne paudhe?

prompt.en: Golu added 245 + 137 and got 3712. What went wrong?
prompt.hi: Golu ne 245 + 137 joda aur 3712 aaya. Kya galat hua?

prompt.en: Add carefully: 245 + 37
prompt.hi: Dhyaan se jodo: 245 + 37

challenges.hint: 37 has 3 tens and 7 ones; line them up under the tens and ones.

prompt.en: A train has 486 people. At a station 235 more get on. The train can carry 750. Is there room?
prompt.hi: Train mein 486 log hain. Station pe 235 aur chadhe. Train mein 750 log aa sakte hain. Kya jagah hai?

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to add 158 + 67.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao ki 158 + 67 kaise jodein.

challenges.hint: Talk about writing one digit and carrying.

prompt.en: Kishan had 568 saplings. He sold 245. How many are left?
prompt.hi: Kishan ke paas 568 paudhe the. Usne 245 beche. Kitne bache?

prompt.en: Subtract: 796 − 354
prompt.hi: Ghatao: 796 − 354

prompt.en: Subtract: 352 − 128
prompt.hi: Ghatao: 352 − 128

challenges.hint: Open a ten: 12 − 8 = 4, and 5 tens become 4 tens.

prompt.en: Subtract: 435 − 172
prompt.hi: Ghatao: 435 − 172

challenges.hint: Open a hundred: 13 tens − 7 tens = 6 tens.

prompt.en: Subtract: 403 − 127
prompt.hi: Ghatao: 403 − 127

challenges.hint: Open a hundred into 10 tens, then a ten into 10 ones: 3 hundreds, 9 tens, 13 ones.

prompt.en: Before subtracting 352 − 128: will you need to open a ten? How do you know?
prompt.hi: 352 − 128 karne se pehle batao: kya dahaai kholni padegi? Kaise pata?

prompt.en: For 352 − 128, {friendF} got 234 and Kavya got 224. Who is right, and what did the other forget?
prompt.hi: 352 − 128 mein {friendF} ko 234 aaya aur Kavya ko 224. Kaun sahi hai, aur doosri kya bhool gayi?

prompt.en: A school has 500 notebooks. 238 are given out. How many are left?
prompt.hi: School mein 500 copiyan hain. 238 baant di gayi. Kitni bachi?

challenges.hint: Open a hundred into 10 tens, then a ten into 10 ones: 4 hundreds, 9 tens, 10 ones.

prompt.en: You saved ₹350 for a cricket bat that costs ₹475. How much more do you need?
prompt.hi: Tumne cricket bat ke liye ₹350 bachaaye. Bat ₹475 ka hai. Aur kitne chahiye?

prompt.en: What is 600 − 200?
prompt.hi: 600 − 200 kitna hai?

prompt.en: Golu has mangoes and wants rice. The rice seller wants shoes, not mangoes. Can they barter?
prompt.hi: Golu ke paas aam hain aur use chaawal chahiye. Chaawal waale ko joote chahiye, aam nahi. Kya woh adla-badli kar sakte hain?

challenges.hint: Barter works only if both want what the other has.

prompt.en: A hawa mithai costs ₹5 and a toffee costs ₹2. How much for both?
prompt.hi: Hawa mithai ₹5 ki aur toffee ₹2 ki hai. Dono kitne ki?

prompt.en: You give ₹50 for a kite that costs ₹28. How much change do you get?
prompt.hi: ₹28 ki patang ke liye ₹50 diye. Kitne wapas milenge?

prompt.en: 3 pencils cost ₹6 each. What is the total cost?
prompt.hi: 3 pencil, har ek ₹6 ki. Kul kitne?

prompt.en: A ₹10 toffee pack is paid for with ₹20. How much change?
prompt.hi: ₹10 ka toffee packet ₹20 se kharida. Kitne wapas milenge?

prompt.en: The long hand is at 12 and the short hand is at 8. What time is it?
prompt.hi: Badi sui 12 pe aur chhoti sui 8 pe hai. Kya time hua?

prompt.en: Which hand is the hour hand: the short one or the long one?
prompt.hi: Ghante wali sui kaunsi hai: chhoti ya badi?

prompt.en: Clock A: short hand at 3, long hand at 12. Clock B: short hand at 12, long hand at 3. Do they show the same time?
prompt.hi: Ghadi A: chhoti sui 3 pe, badi 12 pe. Ghadi B: chhoti sui 12 pe, badi 3 pe. Kya dono ek hi time dikhati hain?

challenges.hint: Read the short hand for the hour.

prompt.en: Golu says the time is 9:03 because the long hand points at 3 and the short hand is just after 9. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai time 9:03 hai kyunki badi sui 3 pe aur chhoti 9 ke thoda aage hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Say 'quarter past 4' another way, and tell where both hands point.
prompt.hi: 'Quarter past 4' ko doosre tarike se bolo, aur batao dono sui kahaan hongi.

prompt.en: The cricket match on TV starts at half past 3. Your clock shows 3 o'clock. How long do you have to wait?
prompt.hi: TV pe cricket match 3:30 baje shuru hoga. Tumhari ghadi mein 3 baje hain. Kitni der rukna padega?

challenges.hint: The long hand goes from 12 to 6.

prompt.en: How many minutes are in one hour?
prompt.hi: Ek ghante mein kitne minute hote hain?

prompt.en: How many days are in a week?
prompt.hi: Ek hafte mein kitne din hote hain?

prompt.en: Before counting: from the 5th to the 9th, is it 4 days or 5 days to wait?
prompt.hi: Ginne se pehle batao: 5 taareekh se 9 taareekh tak 4 din rukna hai ya 5?

prompt.en: Golu says every month has 30 days. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai har mahine mein 30 din hote hain. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A seed was sown on 25 June. It flowered on 3 July. How many days did it take? (June has 30 days.)
prompt.hi: Ek beej 25 June ko boya. 3 July ko phool aaya. Kitne din lage? (June mein 30 din hote hain.)

prompt.en: Your cousin's wedding is 3 weeks from today. Today is 5 December. What date is the wedding?
prompt.hi: Tumhare cousin ki shaadi aaj se 3 hafte baad hai. Aaj 5 December hai. Shaadi kis taareekh ko hai?

prompt.en: 1 October is a Wednesday. Before you check the calendar: is 1 November also a Wednesday?
prompt.hi: 1 October Wednesday hai. Calendar dekhne se pehle batao: kya 1 November bhi Wednesday hai?

challenges.hint: 31 days is 4 weeks and 3 extra days.

prompt.en: How many days are in 2 weeks?
prompt.hi: 2 hafte mein kitne din?

prompt.en: Is the capital letter A symmetrical?
prompt.hi: Kya bada letter A symmetrical hai?

challenges.hint: Do the left and right sides match?

prompt.en: How many lines of symmetry does a square rangoli tile have?
prompt.hi: Square rangoli tile mein symmetry ki kitni lines hain?

challenges.hint: Then try corner to corner, both ways.

prompt.en: Before folding: if I fold a rectangular hanky from corner to corner, will the two halves match?
prompt.hi: Modne se pehle batao: rectangle wale rumaal ko kone se kone modun toh kya dono aadhe milenge?

challenges.hint: Its sides are not all equal.

prompt.en: Golu says a rectangle has 4 lines of symmetry: 2 through the middles and 2 from corner to corner. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai rectangle mein symmetry ki 4 lines hain: 2 beech se aur 2 kone se kone. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Is a patang (kite) symmetrical? Where is the line?
prompt.hi: Kya patang symmetrical hai? Line kahaan hai?

challenges.hint: Fold it from the top point to the bottom point.

prompt.en: On a dot grid, a design has a dot 2 steps to the left of the line of symmetry. Where should the matching dot be?
prompt.hi: Dot grid pe ek design mein ek dot symmetry line se 2 kadam baayein hai. Uska jodidaar dot kahaan hoga?

prompt.en: Which word looks the same when you fold it along a sleeping line through the middle: BOX or CAT?
prompt.hi: Kaunsa shabd beech ki aadi line se modne pe same dikhta hai: BOX ya CAT?

challenges.hint: B, O and X all match top and bottom; A and T do not.

prompt.en: Using 2 red beads and 1 blue bead in a row, list all the ways.
prompt.hi: 2 laal aur 1 neele moti ko ek line mein lagao. Saare tarike likho.

prompt.en: 3 beads in a row, and each bead can be red or blue. How many different rows can you make?
prompt.hi: 3 moti ek line mein, aur har moti laal ya neela ho sakta hai. Kitni alag line ban sakti hain?

challenges.hint: Red first: RR, RB, BR, BB endings = 4.

prompt.en: Golu says that with 2 red and 1 blue bead on a string you can turn around, there are 3 different malas: RRB, RBR, BRR. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Golu kehta hai 2 laal aur 1 neele moti se, ghumaane wali maala mein 3 alag maala banti hain: RRB, RBR, BRR. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A wall border has 3 tiles in a row: 2 white and 1 black. It is fixed and cannot be turned. How many different borders?
prompt.hi: Deewar ki border mein 3 tile ek line mein: 2 safed aur 1 kaali. Yeh fixed hai, ghuma nahi sakte. Kitni alag border?

prompt.en: For a rangoli border you colour 2 squares in a row, using 2 different colours from red, yellow and green. How many ways?
prompt.hi: Rangoli border mein 2 khaane ek line mein rangne hain, laal, peela aur hara mein se 2 alag rang. Kitne tarike?

challenges.hint: Red first: yellow or green. Then yellow first, then green first.

prompt.en: Are red-red-blue and blue-blue-red the same mala?
prompt.hi: Kya laal-laal-neela aur neela-neela-laal ek hi maala hain?

prompt.en: In a fixed row, how many ways can you place 1 blue bead and 2 yellow beads?
prompt.hi: Ek fixed line mein 1 neela aur 2 peele moti kitne tarike se rakh sakte ho?
